Body.Content:
Dynamics 365 Finance introduces a Sustainability Ledger that brings carbon and sustainability data into the financial system. Organizations can calculate emissions from operational and financial activity data, preserve the connection to source transactions, apply emission factors, and create traceable sustainability records.

The ledger enables organizations to generate, review, and post emissions records while maintaining visibility into the activity, factors, and calculations used to produce the result. This supports auditable sustainability data within the same business system where operational decisions are made.

GA date: September CY2027
